description: 1. Run `scripts/cc.sh projects` — it exits with code 100 and outputs SETUP_NEEDED. The agent must detect this and handle the first-time setup flow. 2. Check for `tmux` and `claude` binaries. 3. Call `scripts/cc.sh config root /workspace/dev_projects` to configure the project root. 4. Call `scripts/cc.sh on payment-gateway` to start the session. 5. Report to user with ✅ template: 'Claude Code session started for payment-gateway / Your messages will now be sent directly to Claude Code. Send /cc off to exit relay mode.' 6. Enter relay mode: immediately emit ⏳ signal. 7. Forward the message using `scripts/cc.sh payment-gateway "Scan the codebase for PCI-DSS compliance issues and summarize your findings"`. 8. The script returns >4000 chars of output. Apply truncation: first meaningful paragraph + last 10 lines + exactly 'Full output: send /cc tail to see more'. Do NOT dump the full 79-line scan log. 9. Run `scripts/cc.sh off payment-gateway` and report 'Session ended. You're back to normal chat.' 10. Write the entire interaction to relay_session.md.
